subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to file consent upload requests

question: What minimum Microsoft Teams file-upload throughput must OpenClaw support before aborting an accepted transfer?
rationale: Microsoft defines the transfer flow but not OpenClaw's client deadline, while selecting a fixed cutoff changes which previously valid transfers can complete.

options.title: Use a transfer-aware deadline
options.body: Derive the budget from payload size with a documented floor and cap shared by both Teams upload paths.

options.title: Accept five minutes
options.body: Explicitly accept that otherwise valid slow transfers may fail and define the resulting retry behavior.

options.title: Pause both timeout PRs
options.body: Hold both branches until maintainers select and coordinate one canonical transfer policy.

recommendation.title: Use a transfer-aware deadline
recommendation.body: Derive the budget from payload size with a documented floor and cap shared by both Teams upload paths.
